fichas.title: Vegetation: Plants and Lawns
fichas.summary: Guidance on planting and anchoring trees, respecting property boundaries, plant and lawn acceptance, and soil preparation. Illustrations show planting and staking methods, soil layers, hedge growth heights, and standards for sorting and bundling standard trees.
uses: Anchor and protect newly planted trees
Establish and maintain lawns and ground-cover planting
Determine planting distances from property boundaries

dimensions.label: Planting-hole width multiplier
dimensions.context: Planting-hole width relative to root-ball width.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Planting holes should be dug with a width of 1.5 times the root ball.

dimensions.label: Hedge planting distance for hedges up to 2.0 m high
dimensions.context: Distance from neighbouring property boundary; measured from the side surface.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Hedges up to a height of 2.0 m should be planted at a distance of 0.50 m

dimensions.label: Hedge height threshold
dimensions.context: Height threshold distinguishing the stated hedge boundary distances.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Hedges up to a height of 2.0 m

dimensions.label: Hedge planting distance for hedges over 2.0 m high
dimensions.context: Distance from neighbouring property boundary; measured from the side surface.
dimensions.ocr_raw: or if over 2.0 m in height at 1.0 m

dimensions.label: Small-tree planting distance
dimensions.context: Distance from neighbouring property boundary, measured from the centre of the trunk.
dimensions.ocr_raw: small trees at a distance of 1.50 m

dimensions.label: Large-tree planting distance
dimensions.context: Distance from neighbouring property boundary, measured from the centre of the trunk.
dimensions.ocr_raw: large trees at 3.0 m. (measured from the centre of the trunk).

dimensions.label: Maximum dead plants for acceptable area planting
dimensions.context: Ground-cover planting is acceptable at this maximum if its appearance remains continuous.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Area (ground-cover) planting is acceptable when no more than 5% of the plants have died

dimensions.label: Minimum fertile soil layer for lawns
dimensions.ocr_raw: For lawn areas, a fertile soil layer of at least 10 cm should be prepared.

dimensions.label: Grass growth temperature threshold
dimensions.context: Grass generally grows above approximately this temperature.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Grass generally grows at temperatures above approx. 8°C

dimensions.label: Grass growth stopping temperature
dimensions.context: Grass stops growing at approximately this temperature.

dimensions.label: Wait before using newly sown lawn
dimensions.context: Approximate period before a newly sown lawn can be used.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A newly sown lawn can be used after about six weeks.

dimensions.label: Minimum acceptable lawn cover
dimensions.context: Approximate cover required for sowing work to be acceptable.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Sowing work is acceptable when a cover of approx. 75% is reached.

dimensions.label: Minimum projective ground cover for landscape grass areas
dimensions.context: Approximate cover for acceptance of landscape grass areas.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Landscape grass areas are acceptable with a projective ground cover of approx. 50%.
